purpose: Agreement of fixed local models with the deployed author server on 200 new DNA inputs; no experimental activity analysis or performance estimation.
source: Agarwal, Inoue et al. Nature 2025, Table S10 joint library design
insert_rule: Require the observed fixed 15-base adapters and 230 A/C/G/T bases; retain positions 16 through 215 (1-based).
coordinate_eligibility: Require an annotated hg19 interval of 200 bases, chr1-22/X/Y, and a defined +/- strand in S10. This excludes records with only hg38 coordinates and synthetic/shuffled controls without hg19 positions.
selection: Sort by SHA256(seed + newline + canonical insert), breaking ties by construct name. Select eligible, distinct canonical inserts until 200 pass all declared screens.
training_set: All 2968 original benchmark sequences; both orientations; verified file hashes.
exclusions: Global unit-cost Levenshtein distance <=40 to any training sequence in either orientation
Source hg19 interval overlaps or lies within 1000 bases of any training interval
Exact/reverse-complement duplicate, <=40 edits, or within 1000 bases of an already selected record
primary_endpoint: Exact final class-label agreement per 200-base query.
secondary_endpoints: Strong/weak agreement among records where both predict enhancer
limitations: Agreement is not ground-truth predictive accuracy or full reproduction.
hg19 coordinates are used as annotated in the publication; no new assembly lookup or liftover is performed.
The available original benchmark can be screened, but the deployed server's complete training history is not exposed.
No lentiMPRA activity labels are used or evaluated.
The finite similarity and proximity rules do not prove complete biological independence.
